symptom: `theme create --from <design> --base console` writes `_mxcli-<name>.scss` with a stray `}}`/`}` where the @font-face section was (27 `{` vs 29 `}`); the theme does not compile. Same for --base signal and ledger
cause: `dropFontFaces` matched each `@each $weight { @font-face { … } }` block with `[^}]*\}[^}]*\}`; the `src: url("…-#{$weight}-…")` interpolation's `}` ended the first span early, so the match stopped at the @font-face close and left the @each's `}`
insight: Never match nested SCSS blocks with `[^}]*`; count braces (interpolations are balanced). The existing test used the real shape but asserted only absence of @font-face — any rewrite of a stylesheet should assert brace balance on every shipped asset. Not copying the fonts folder is intended when the design's font stacks name none of the vendored families
